repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Claim: PM loop · 2026-11-22T02:22Z · #35795: the list reads approval locks for a page of rows in one request, through a new batch route that mirrors the batched explain read. While a row's lock or record verdict is still unread, a cell on that row opens no editor and says 「正在确认这条记录能否编辑」. Arrow-key moves send no per-row request.
Area: b1-L (epic #35683)
Session: `session_01L6bhgXSK9qt8je9QbZvhKb` (card thread)
Account: `os-sales`
Branch: claude/project-thread-ahwb54 (one PR, `Fixes #35795`)
File surface: approvals REST routes (`POST /api/v1/approvals/records/:object/locks`, body `{ recordIds }`, cap 200 as explain) · `IApprovalService` optional `getRecordLocks` in `packages/spec` contracts, with single and batch sharing one verdict function · SDK `approvals.getRecordLocks` plus its ledger row · `ui/packages/plugin-grid` `useRowApprovalLocks.ts` and the data-table read-only reason `checking` (real text in all ten locales) · tests with fake timers.
Container & model: `M`, card thread, `model: opus`, `effort: high`
Clause-②: yes (widening): a new route, an optional service-contract member and an SDK method.
Metadata-protocol: none
Premise (PR body's top lines): holds. Projecting the lock into the list read would make the data layer know about approvals and charge every list read; a batch route keeps the verdict with the approvals plugin. The card's "opens nothing and says the record is being checked" arm is taken; auto-opening once the answer lands is not, since it would need an async editor entry.
Reviews: L1-b; contract L2 at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` (spec contract face) run by the seat.
Resume-from: none
Fold-or-serial: serial. Overlap: #36135 also edits `getRecordLock`. Whoever lands second brings the shared verdict function up to date. #36144 edits `approval-service.ts` but not the lock read.
